result.rationale: The claimed failure mechanism is contradicted by the code shown: the query `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` lowercases the stored value, and the comparison value comes from `uri.host` (from `record_for_host`), which Ruby's URI parser already returns lowercased. So an uppercase stored host is normalized by `lower()` on the left side and matched against an already-lowercase right side; the described 'never match' breakage does not follow from the diff.

judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:14-19 — record_for_host does `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` without lowercasing the right-hand `host` value (from `uri.host`, not case-normalized), so any stored host with uppercase characters (permitted by the case-insensitive `/i` format regex, and not downcased in `before_validation`) will never match at request time, silently breaking embedding for those hosts .
